problem: The trusted diff policy classifies Defold collection/game-object/script bootstrap resources as player-facing and therefore requires exact-head rendered evidence, but the repository has no runtime evidence workflow before P0 begins. Adding that workflow in the same runtime PR would itself be a governance-critical change and force an incompatible process classification.

decision.rationale: Add a narrowly scoped pull_request workflow in its own process-only PR. It checks out the exact PR head with read-only permissions, builds through the repository's pinned Defold build tool, captures a browser frame and retains the runtime files without changing the required trusted validator or main ruleset.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Bob is the supported command-line builder; current Bob requires OpenJDK 25, supports debug/release variants, settings overlays, wasm-web and explicit bundle-output.
Defold recommends Bob for editor-independent CI and documents archive/build/bundle automation as a verification path.

alternatives.reason: Preserves the existing trusted pull_request_target boundary while giving later runtime PRs a real exact-head HTML5 artifact and screenshot source.

The trusted governance classifier requires any workflow-changing PR to use process class, while the BB-001 runtime files require player-facing classification; combining them cannot satisfy both policies.
Would violate R-008/R-014 by substituting prose or synthetic evidence for an observed exact-head rendered result.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The runner executes candidate runtime code only under pull_request with contents:read and no repository-write or secret permissions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/defold-runtime-evidence.yml declares pull_request and permissions.contents=read; checkout disables persisted credentials.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The runner binds evidence to github.event.pull_request.head.sha and retains both HTML5 bundles plus a 1280x720 browser capture.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Workflow checks out the exact head SHA, writes head-sha.txt, captures bootstrap-1280x720.png and uploads development/release bundles with a SHA-keyed artifact name.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The new workflow does not modify the existing required validate-pr-evidence trust path or main ruleset.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Diff adds a separate non-required workflow and this manifest only; .github/workflows/pr-evidence-trusted.yml, policy scripts and ruleset configuration are unchanged.

automated: Trusted-base validate-pr-evidence will classify and validate this process PR before merge.
manual: Static workflow review confirms exact-head checkout, read-only permissions, pinned action commits, pinned-JDK setup and SHA-keyed retained artifact naming.
verification.runtime_errors: Not applicable to this process-only prerequisite PR; the first runtime execution is intentionally triggered by the following BB-001 runtime diff.

governance.trust_boundary_change: Adds a separate non-required pull_request evidence runner that executes candidate runtime code with contents:read only. It does not alter the pull_request_target trusted validator, required status context, policy source, branch ruleset, approvals or bypass actors.
governance.bypass_analysis: The new job cannot satisfy or replace validate-pr-evidence, has no write permission or secrets, checks out the exact candidate head only for runtime evidence, and does not execute in the privileged pull_request_target context. Candidate changes therefore cannot use this workflow to rewrite trusted policy or bypass the required ruleset check.
governance.rollback: Delete .github/workflows/defold-runtime-evidence.yml in a process-class governance PR. The existing required validate-pr-evidence workflow and main ruleset continue functioning independently.

known_limitations: The workflow is intentionally non-required until the later P0 CI milestone decides which runtime checks belong in the protected required set.
End-to-end execution is deferred to the first matching runtime PR because this process-only PR does not contain game.project or Defold runtime paths.
